summary: This directory centralizes the definition, registry management, and identification of AI models. It provides a structured mechanism to configure, retrieve, and inject various language and embedding models into the application context.
responsibilities: Define identifiers for supported AI models
Maintain a registry of available AI and embedding models
Provide accessors to retrieve configured models
Define service context for AI model management
relationships: AI model identifiers map to specific entries within the AI model registry.
The registry service provides access to both language models and embedding models.
Effect layers facilitate the dependency injection of the configured model registry into the application.
designDecisions: Use of Effect Context Service for dependency management
Centralized registry pattern for model retrieval
